title: Product Manager OS local engineering readiness
note: This is a fixed 100-point local engineering rubric. Every point is all-or-nothing and bound to an opaque argv-only verifier in tools/readiness_registry.py. Documentation alone earns no credit. Live provider, hosted CI, vendor sandbox, non-maintainer adoption, organization-specific regulatory, team-review, and published-release attestations are reported separately by docs/readiness/external-gates.json.

criteria.title: Six stages, six gates, and required operating artifacts are internally consistent
A contract-checked local integration matrix executes required operating slices with typed evidence and independently observed API seams
Typed organizations, products, initiatives, opportunities, experiments, releases, decisions, risks, evidence, metrics, approvals, dependencies, and allocations exist
Several initiatives progress independently through validated lifecycle transitions and gates
Typed traceability and history remain non-dangling across the product graph
Initializer and runner share one canonical destination resolver for every manifest route
Inline, reference, titled, angled, spaced, anchored, and encoded links use one grammar
A fully generated workspace has zero broken links or source-template semantic drift
Installation is complete, idempotent, and preserves canonical workspace identity
The documented workspace golden path executes and finishes visibly green
Every route has an executable typed contract and the human and machine routers agree
The Conductor persists question cursors, accepted answers, challenges, gate proof, resume, bounded-window idempotency, and conflicts
Dynamic model routing enforces capability, context, latency, budget, privacy, risk, certification, provenance, and bounded fallback
OpenRouter free-model discovery and completion are runtime-resolved, bounded, and secret-safe
Claude Code project hooks cover the complete development loop and fail closed
PM runtime hooks enforce transition, commit, provider, external-effect, and completion boundaries
Runtime skills have typed inputs, outputs, semantics, resources, versions, hashes, and fail-closed validation

categories.title: Transactions, concurrency, queue, memory, and recovery

criteria.title: Full snapshots are content-addressed and atomically visible through prepare and publish
Local concurrency and cross-store commit packs use compare-and-swap with explicit conflicts
The queue enforces deduplication, leases, fencing, heartbeats, retries, cancellation, deadlines, and dead letters
OS and per-task memory are isolated, append-only, classed, promotable, tombstoned, rebuildable, and tamper-evident
Real process kills before and after prepare, publish, queue, and memory commits reveal only a complete prior or new state
Backup, restore, verification, run identity, and idempotency survive reopen

categories.title: Governance, security, privacy, regulatory evidence, and audit

criteria.title: Host-supplied actor identity and least-privilege authorization are enforced at the domain write boundary
Audit history and exports are immutable, hash-chained, attributable, and replay-verifiable
Regulated approvals bind authority, policy, time, and evidence hashes and support drift invalidation, revocation, and re-approval
Privacy, retention, consent, redaction, provider boundaries, and external effects fail closed
Adversarial checks cover secrets, traversal, injection, unsafe execution, tampering, and dependency boundaries
Metrics and research quotes retain freshness, consent, and evidence lineage
Threats, trust boundaries, dependency policy, and residual exceptions are documented and executable
Assignments, comments, mentions, decisions, and approvals retain actor identity
Concurrent edits return an explicit actionable revision conflict instead of losing an update
Portfolio scoring, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and rollups preserve initiative history
The mandatory matrix executes contract-checked multi-user and multi-product local slices

categories.title: Integrations, analytics, experiments, research, and delivery

criteria.title: Issue tracking, source control, analytics, research storage, and notification adapters share versioned contracts
Metric ingestion enforces definition, freshness, source, unit, and lineage
Experiment outcomes link typed experiments to recorded decisions
Research operations enforce consent, recruiting state, retention, redaction, deletion, and quote scope
The transactional outbox exposes degraded state, bounded retry, dead-letter, acknowledgement, and reconciliation

categories.title: CI, evaluator integrity, packaging, migrations, and release provenance

criteria.title: Every shipped root, harness, and regulated test runs with positive counts and zero skipped or expected failures
Hosted workflow invokes the canonical code-owned runtime gate across supported Python versions
Fresh-tree mutation checks prove every targeted defect makes its owning gate fail for the intended reason
Offline packaging, forward migration, rollback, backup, restore, and release provenance are executable
The rubric, task ledger, verifier registry, evidence counts, output location, and external-lane separation resist tampering
An exact-tree local review record has no unresolved P0 or P1 and does not claim authenticated reviewer identity

categories.title: New-user experience, accessibility, and honest adoption evidence

criteria.title: A new user can initialize, inspect, verify, and recover through documented human and JSON CLI output
Key operator documentation and output conventions pass an executable accessibility review
README, runtime quickstart, API, CLI, and maturity claims agree with executable capability
A consent-aware observation mechanism records adoption evidence without claiming external adoption occurred
